table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	item.customicode,
	purdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	item.name, 
	currlistrow = 0,
	totalstock=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.ICode=dbo.purdetail.Icode), 0),
	stock=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.GCode=dbo.purdetail.gcode AND GD.ICode=dbo.purdetail.Icode), 0),
	QuickSearch=SPACE(100),
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	location = purdetail.location,
	dbo.purdetail.icode,
	dbo.purdetail.batch,
	dbo.purdetail.manfdate,
	dbo.purdetail.expiry,
	dbo.purdetail.gcode,
	dbo.purdetail.packqty,   
	dbo.purdetail.looseqty,
	dbo.purdetail.bonusqty,
	dbo.purdetail.foreignprice,
	dbo.purdetail.packunits,      
	basicpackunits=dbo.item.packunits,
	dbo.purdetail.totalpieces,
	dbo.purdetail.piecesinhand,
	dbo.purdetail.purinvcode,
	dbo.purdetail.avgprice,
	dbo.purdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	prediscprice = dbo.purdetail.purprice + dbo.purdetail.itemflatdisc,
	dbo.purdetail.itemflatdisc,
	dbo.purdetail.purprice,
	dbo.purdetail.gstperc,
	dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
	ExtraTaxPerc=max((((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax) / CASE WHEN (purdetail.LooseQty * purdetail.PurPrice * (1 - purdetail.DiscPerc * 0.01)) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE (purdetail.LooseQty * purdetail.purPrice * (1 - purdetail.DiscPerc * 0.01)) END) * 100),
	dbo.purdetail.netrate,
	dbo.purdetail.recentpurprice,
	dbo.purdetail.saleprice,
	dbo.purdetail.salepriceforitem,
	dbo.purdetail.BatchSalePrice,
	dbo.purdetail.LockBatch,
	dbo.purdetail.LockReasonCode,
	dbo.purdetail.godownstock,
	dbo.purdetail.rate,
	dbo.purdetail.purpriceinadvpur,
	dbo.purdetail.itemdescription,
	dbo.purdetail.ManfCodeforitem,
	dbo.purdetail.DiscountedSalePrice,
	salediscperc=item.salediscperc,
	ValueExTax = SUM(( dbo.purdetail.purprice * dbo.purdetail.packqty) * (1 - ( dbo.purdetail.discperc  * .01))),
	PackCapacity = item.PackCapacity,
	AreaVolume = item.AreaVolume,
	PCS=ROUND(sum(purdetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6),
	Cartons= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CAST(((ROUND(sum(purdetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6)) / CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END) AS INT), 7, 0))) + ' : ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(((CAST(ROUND(sum(purdetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6) AS INT)) % CAST(CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END AS INT)), 7, 0))),
	dbo.purdetail.unitweight,
	Taxable = Item.Taxable,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc = MAX(purdetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc),
	SalesTaxScheduleCode=purdetail.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
	PCTCode = purdetail.PCTCode,
	ItemAlertCode = purdetail.ItemAlertCode,
	dbo.purdetail.discperc

FROM 
	dbo.purdetail , 
   dbo.item

WHERE 
	( dbo.purdetail.purinvcode = :r_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.purdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode ) 

GROUP BY
	item.customicode,
	purdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	item.name, 
	item.packingdesc,
	purdetail.location,
	dbo.purdetail.icode,
	dbo.purdetail.batch,
	dbo.purdetail.manfdate,
	dbo.purdetail.expiry,
	dbo.purdetail.gcode,
	dbo.purdetail.packqty,   
	dbo.purdetail.looseqty,
	dbo.purdetail.bonusqty,
	dbo.purdetail.foreignprice,
	dbo.purdetail.packunits,  
	dbo.item.packunits,    
	dbo.purdetail.totalpieces,
	dbo.purdetail.piecesinhand,
	dbo.purdetail.itemflatdisc,
	dbo.purdetail.purprice,   
	dbo.purdetail.purinvcode,
	dbo.purdetail.avgprice,
	dbo.purdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	dbo.purdetail.newavgprice,
	dbo.purdetail.currstock,
	dbo.purdetail.godownstock,
	dbo.purdetail.purutn ,
	dbo.purdetail.gstperc,
	dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
	dbo.purdetail.netrate,
	dbo.purdetail.recentpurprice,
	dbo.purdetail.saleprice,
	dbo.purdetail.rate,
	dbo.purdetail.purpriceinadvpur,
	dbo.purdetail.itemdescription,
	dbo.purdetail.salepriceforitem,
	dbo.purdetail.BatchSalePrice,
	dbo.purdetail.LockBatch,
	dbo.purdetail.LockReasonCode,
	dbo.purdetail.DiscountedSalePrice,
	dbo.purdetail.unitweight,
	item.PackCapacity,
	item.AreaVolume,
	item.salediscperc,
	Item.Taxable,
	dbo.purdetail.discperc,
	dbo.purdetail.ManfCodeforitem,
	purdetail.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
	purdetail.PCTCode,
	purdetail.ItemAlertCode

objects.name: d_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum( ( ( purprice  *  looseqty )  + ( purprice  *  packqty) ) *  ( 1- ( discperc  * .01  ) )   for all)

objects.name: d_detaildwforeigntotal
objects.expression: sum ( ( foreignprice  *  looseqty )  + ( foreignprice * packqty ) ) *  ( 1- ( discperc  * .01  ) )

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: sum( number(mid(cartons, 1, pos( cartons , ':', 1)-1)) for all) + ' : ' + SUM(number(mid(cartons, pos( cartons , ':', 1)+1, len(cartons))) for all)

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: AVG(Round( ((salepriceforitem - ((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits) ) / if(salepriceforitem=0,1, salepriceforitem)) * 100, 2 ) for all)

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: AVG(Round( ((((salepriceforitem) * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)) - ((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits) ) / if(((salepriceforitem) * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)) =0,1, ((salepriceforitem) * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)))) * 100, 2 ) for all)

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: AVG(Round ( ((salepriceforitem - ((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits)) / if(((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits) = 0, 1, ((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits)) ) * 100 , 2 ) for all)
